# agentic-carousel

Build platform-ready carousels from an outline.

Keywords: carousel,instagram,linkedin,slides,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-carousel".
- CLI: agentic-carousel summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-carousel mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
